verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents a full developer API for managing, updating, embedding and chatting with workspaces. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec with 67 /v1 paths in its official repo, and each instance serves Swagger UI docs at /api/docs. The probe 404s on the docs site do not contradict this, because the spec is served per instance rather than from the docs domain. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, a vendor-hosted public API or demo instance, and an API-contract changelog or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: AnythingLLM supports a full developer API that you can use to manage, update, embed, and even chat with your workspaces
API endpoints that enable programmatic reading, writing, and updating of your AnythingLLM instance. UI supplied by Swagger.io.
You can find the API documentation for available endpoints on your instance at /api/docs
